import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")


# Preprocess text
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    return str(text).lower().replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", "")


train["comment_text"] = train["comment_text"].apply(clean_text)
test["comment_text"] = test["comment_text"].apply(clean_text)

# Split training data
# Separate features and targets
X = train[["comment_text"]].copy()
y = train[
    ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
].values
ids = train["id"].values

# Split train/val
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val, ids_train, ids_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, ids, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y if y.ndim == 1 else None
)

# TF-IDF Vectorization
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 1), stop_words="english")
X_train_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train["comment_text"])
X_val_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_val["comment_text"])
X_test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(test["comment_text"])

# Define target columns
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Train models and calculate validation ROC AUC
models = []
val_scores = []

for i, target in enumerate(target_cols):
    model = LGBMClassifier(
        learning_rate=0.05,
        n_estimators=200,
        max_depth=6,
        num_leaves=31,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    model.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train[:, i])
    models.append(model)

    val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)[:, 1]
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], val_pred)
    val_scores.append(auc)

mean_auc = np.mean(val_scores)
print(f"Validation Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Generate submission
test_ids = test["id"].values
predictions = np.zeros((len(test_ids), len(target_cols)))

for i, model in enumerate(models):
    prob = model.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)[:, 1]
    predictions[:, i] = prob

# Create submission dataframe
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"id": test_ids, **{col: predictions[:, i] for i, col in enumerate(target_cols)}}
)

# Ensure column order matches sample_submission
submission = submission[["id"] + target_cols]

# Save
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
